name: How can I prevent shower drain clogs from happening?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent shower drain clogs from happening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preventing shower drain clogs involves consistent maintenance and mindful habits. Key steps include installing a drain screen to catch hair and soap residue, regularly flushing the drain with hot water, and avoiding pouring grease or harsh chemicals down the drain. For effective prevention, occasionally pouring a mixture of baking soda and vinegar down the drain, followed by hot water, can help break down minor buildup. This proactive approach can significantly extend the time between professional cleanings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using drain screens, flushing with hot water, and avoiding harmful substances; regular maintenance is key.
